mapper.select: SELECT ba.apply_id, ba.apply_no, ba.budget_year, ba.item_id, ba.item_code, ba.item_name, ba.subject_id, ba.subject_code, ba.subject_name, ba.apply_amount, ba.apply_reason, ba.status, ba.process_definition_id, ba.process_instance_id, ba.applicant_id, ba.applicant_code, ba.applicant_name, ba.dept_id, ba.dept_code, COALESCE(d.dept_name, ba.dept_name, '') AS dept_name, COALESCE(ba.applicant_phone, e.emp_phone, '') AS applicant_phone, ba.template_config_id, ba.main_attach_id, ba.apply_date, ba.create_user, ba.create_time, ba.update_time FROM budget_apply ba LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON ba.applicant_id = e.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON ba.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE ba.apply_id = #{id}

SELECT ba.apply_id, ba.apply_no, ba.budget_year, ba.item_id, ba.item_code, ba.item_name, ba.subject_id, ba.subject_code, ba.subject_name, ba.apply_amount, ba.apply_reason, ba.status, ba.process_definition_id, ba.process_instance_id, ba.applicant_id, ba.applicant_code, ba.applicant_name, ba.dept_id, ba.dept_code, COALESCE(d.dept_name, ba.dept_name, '') AS dept_name, COALESCE(ba.applicant_phone, e.emp_phone, '') AS applicant_phone, ba.template_config_id, ba.main_attach_id, ba.apply_date, ba.create_user, ba.create_time, ba.update_time FROM budget_apply ba LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON ba.applicant_id = e.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON ba.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE ba.apply_no = #{applyNo}

SELECT ba.apply_id, ba.apply_no, ba.budget_year, ba.item_id, ba.item_code, ba.item_name, ba.subject_id, ba.subject_code, ba.subject_name, ba.apply_amount, ba.apply_reason, ba.status, ba.process_definition_id, ba.process_instance_id, ba.applicant_id, ba.applicant_code, ba.applicant_name, ba.dept_id, ba.dept_code, COALESCE(d.dept_name, ba.dept_name, '') AS dept_name, COALESCE(e.emp_phone, '') AS applicant_phone, ba.template_config_id, ba.main_attach_id, ba.apply_date, ba.create_user, ba.create_time, ba.update_time FROM budget_apply ba LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON ba.applicant_id = e.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON ba.dept_id = d.dept_id ORDER BY ba.create_time DESC

SELECT ba.*, COALESCE(d.dept_name, ba.dept_name, '') AS dept_name, COALESCE(ba.applicant_phone, e.emp_phone, '') AS applicant_phone FROM budget_apply ba LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON ba.applicant_id = e.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON ba.dept_id = d.dept_id ORDER BY ba.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT ba.apply_id, ba.apply_no, ba.budget_year, ba.item_id, ba.item_code, ba.item_name, ba.subject_id, ba.subject_code, ba.subject_name, ba.apply_amount, ba.apply_reason, ba.status, ba.process_definition_id, ba.process_instance_id, ba.applicant_id, ba.applicant_code, ba.applicant_name, ba.dept_id, ba.dept_code, COALESCE(d.dept_name, ba.dept_name, '') AS dept_name, COALESCE(e.emp_phone, '') AS applicant_phone, ba.template_config_id, ba.main_attach_id, ba.apply_date, ba.create_user, ba.create_time, ba.update_time FROM budget_apply ba LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON ba.applicant_id = e.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON ba.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE ba.item_id = #{itemId} AND ba.status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY ba.create_time DESC
SELECT MAX(apply_no) FROM budget_apply WHERE apply_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO budget_apply (apply_no, budget_year, item_id, item_code, item_name, subject_id, subject_code, subject_name, apply_amount, apply_reason, status, process_definition_id, process_instance_id, applicant_id, applicant_code, applicant_name, dept_id, dept_code, dept_name, applicant_phone, template_config_id, main_attach_id, apply_date, create_user, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{applyNo}, #{budgetYear}, #{itemId}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{subjectId}, #{subjectCode}, #{subjectName}, #{applyAmount}, #{applyReason}, #{status}, #{processDefinitionId}, #{processInstanceId}, #{applicantId}, #{applicantCode}, #{applicantName}, #{deptId}, #{deptCode}, #{deptName}, #{applicantPhone}, #{templateConfigId}, #{mainAttachId}, #{applyDate}, #{createUser}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
